title: Homocentric Chirality and Magnetism Enable Strong NIR Magneto-Optical Activity in a Chiral DyFe Cluster

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: R enantiomer of the chiral DyFe3 cluster

synthesis.procedure: The R chiral Schiff-base ligand was reacted with iron(III) perchlorate hydrate and dysprosium chloride hexahydrate in a mixed solution; triethylamine was used for pH adjustment. The main article does not give reagent quantities.
synthesis.time: 5 minutes before and 5 minutes after triethylamine addition; 2 days of evaporation
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Stirred in a flask; triethylamine solution added dropwise
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered into a clean 25 mL beaker; evaporation at room temperature yielded dark red bulk crystals.
synthesis.yield: approximately 47.8% based on dysprosium chloride hexahydrate

properties.summary: The crystals show a low-temperature susceptibility upturn consistent with Dy–Fe magnetic interaction, with possible contributions from Dy single-ion anisotropy and crystal-field depopulation. The enantiomer exhibits natural circular dichroism and a strong, reversible field-dependent NIR CD response, including signal inversion.

measurements.name: NIR CD intensity enhancement at the Dy(III) ⁶H₁₅/₂ → ⁶F₁₁/₂ transition
measurements.conditions: Applied magnetic field of ±1.6 T relative to zero field; room temperature; reported for R/S-DyFe3

measurements.name: dissymmetry-factor enhancement at the Dy(III) ⁶H₁₅/₂ → ⁶F₁₁/₂ transition
measurements.conditions: Applied magnetic field relative to zero field; reported for R/S-DyFe3

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A central Dy(III) ion links three twisted-octahedral [Fe(III)(R-L)2] units into a discrete, three-bladed propeller-like [DyFe3(R-L)6] cluster. The Dy coordination environment is described as a twisted triangular prism.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: S enantiomer of the chiral DyFe3 cluster

synthesis.procedure: The S chiral Schiff-base ligand was reacted with iron(III) perchlorate hydrate and dysprosium chloride hexahydrate in a mixed solution; triethylamine was used for pH adjustment. The main article does not give reagent quantities.
synthesis.time: 5 minutes before and 5 minutes after triethylamine addition; 2 days of evaporation
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Stirred in a flask; triethylamine solution added dropwise
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered into a clean 25 mL beaker; evaporation at room temperature yielded dark red bulk crystals.
synthesis.yield: approximately 49% based on dysprosium chloride hexahydrate

properties.summary: Its natural CD spectrum is approximately mirror-symmetric to that of R-DyFe3. The NIR Dy(III) f–f CD response is strongly enhanced and inverted by an applied magnetic field and is reversible.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The S enantiomer has the corresponding three-bladed propeller-like DyFe3 architecture. The article describes the R structure in detail and identifies the two crystal structures as opposite chiral configurations.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: R enantiomer of the DyCo3 analogue

material_class.structural_family: chiral DyCo3 analogue of the three-bladed propeller cluster

synthesis.procedure: Synthesized as an isostructural analogue of R-DyFe3 by replacing Fe(III) with low-spin Co(III); the main article does not provide a preparation with reagent quantities.
synthesis.time: 5 minutes before and 30 minutes after triethylamine addition; 2 days of evaporation
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Stirred in a flask; triethylamine solution added dropwise
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered into a clean 25 mL beaker; evaporation at room temperature yielded brown bulk crystals.
synthesis.yield: approximately 41.8% based on dysprosium chloride hexahydrate

properties.summary: The analogue retains the chiral Dy-centered environment. Its NIR Dy(III) f–f CD signals are enhanced and inverted under a magnetic field, but less strongly than in R/S-DyFe3.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: R enantiomer of the YFe3 analogue

material_class.structural_family: chiral YFe3 analogue of the three-bladed propeller cluster

synthesis.procedure: Synthesized as an isostructural analogue of R-DyFe3 by replacing Dy(III) with Y(III); the main article does not provide a preparation with reagent quantities.
synthesis.time: 5 minutes before and 5 minutes after triethylamine addition; 2 days of evaporation
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Stirred in a flask; triethylamine solution added dropwise
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered into a clean 25 mL beaker; evaporation at room temperature yielded dark red bulk crystals.
synthesis.yield: approximately 41.2% based on yttrium chloride hexahydrate

properties.summary: The YFe3 control shows Fe(III) d–d optical transitions but lacks NIR Dy f–f features. No detectable field-induced CD inversion or strong enhancement was observed at 1.6 T.

material_class.structural_family: chiral YFe3 analogue of the three-bladed propeller cluster

synthesis.procedure: Synthesized as an isostructural analogue of S-DyFe3 by replacing Dy(III) with Y(III); the main article does not provide a preparation with reagent quantities.
synthesis.time: 5 minutes before and 5 minutes after triethylamine addition; 2 days of evaporation
